lines.say: In nineteen eighty-one, two skywalks fell into a crowded hotel lobby in Kansas City.
Each walkway hung from steel rods.
Under the top walkway's beam, a single nut and washer held everything up.
The original design used one long rod through both walkways.
The steel fabricator split it in two, and the engineer approved the change over the phone, without checking the numbers.
That doubled the load on the nut.
It held only thirty percent of what the code required, and it tore straight through the beam.
Sixteen hundred people were at a tea dance that night. One hundred and fourteen never went home.
